No repo edits or commands are part of the simulation.

assertions.text: Targets exactly the existing zh-CN key and preserves the unrelated edit in the same file.
Uses the documented focused translation command and compares the pre-existing and final diff.
Keeps the workflow local and focused without adding files, workflow stages, or unrelated checks.

assertions.text: Defines a deterministic frontend replay where completed arrives before an older running response and checks the final visible state.
